data.name: Brasília Defense
data.detailed_description:
Shield a frozen Brasília from relentless hordes marching across the city’s landmarks. In Brasília Defense, a strategic tower defense, every choice matters: place towers, deploy heroes, manage resources, and swing the battle with well-timed special powers.

Face escalating waves across maps inspired by Brasília’s regions, reimagined in a glacial setting full of atmosphere and detail. Mix tower types, upgrades, and hero abilities to craft unique defenses and adapt your strategy to each mission.

What to expect

  • 5 selectable heroes with distinct combat styles and abilities that synergize with your towers.

  • Upgradeable towers to build, evolve, and create powerful synergies that hold the line.

  • 3 clutch specials: call dragons, meteors, and mercenaries to turn the tide when it matters most.

  • Many enemy types with varied behaviors and resistances—watch out for fliers!

  • 8 thematic maps set in a glacial Brasília, paired with an original soundtrack to heighten the action.

Why you’ll like it

  • Personality-driven strategy: powers, and upgrade paths enable multiple answers to the same challenge.

  • Rising challenge curve: scaling waves reward planning, timing, and smart countermeasures.

  • Immersive audiovisuals: handcrafted environments and an original score deliver epic defensive battles.

Awards & recognition

  • Selected by the Lei Paulo Gustavo – DF cultural grant.

Ready your defenses, rally your heroes, and prove that the chill of the high plains is no match for sharp strategy. Brasília Defense awaits on the battlefield.

data.short_description: Brasília Defense is a strategy and tower-defense game that turns the landmarks and regions of the Federal District into an epic battlefield. Inspired by local culture, it blends post-apocalyptic fiction, original art, and engaging mechanics.
